items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, she was before Billie, and she sang The 'White Cliffs of Dover,' and it was a big hit -- and this guy, he made a record.

ctx.x: She was the first one I heard do 'God Bless The Child.' I remember her doing it before Billie Holiday.
Yeah, she was before Billie, and she sang The 'White Cliffs of Dover,' and it was a big hit -- and this guy, he made a record.
